title: Sycophancy under Pressure: Evaluating and Mitigating Sycophantic Bias via Adversarial Dialogues in Scientific QA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models in single-turn and multi-turn scientific QA settings by injecting misleading cues or confounding user feedback into prompts, and measuring the rate at which models abandon factual accuracy to align with the user's incorrect suggestions (sycophancy resistance rate).
